subject: Mutual action plan: implementation sprint, canary migration & training slots
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novaleap.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Dec 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan: implementation sprint, canary migration & training slots

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the signature yesterday and for the quick turnaround on the SOW. Per our call I’m attaching an initial implementation sprint that embeds the MAP milestones (rollout phases, canary migration windows, and training cadence). The attachment is the working XLSX: MAP-implementation-schedule.xlsx (sheet tabs: Timeline, Canary Gating, Training).

High level ask from our side:
- Please confirm the preferred production cutover week (options shown in Timeline tab).
- Confirm two primary contacts on your side for canary ops (prod rollback authority + DB lead).
- Pick three candidate training windows next week so we can lock trainers.

We’ve assigned Marissa as the overall PM for the rollout and Soojin will lead the canary gating and runbook handoff. We’ll follow a staged rollout: internal pilot -> limited canary in region-us-west -> full traffic shift with surge capacity. The schedule includes hold windows for perf-eval and a rollback freeze 24 hours before full shift.

Attachments: MAP-implementation-schedule.xlsx; canary-runbook-v1.pdf; training-slots.ics

Thanks — looking forward to getting the dates locked.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novaleap.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@novaleap.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Dec 2025 09:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: implementation sprint, canary migration & training slots

Thanks Dylan —

Received the sheet and runbook. Quick answers:
- Production cutover: our preference is the week of Jan 12 (Jan 12–16). That gives our infra team time to complete the security baseline.
- Canary contacts: Tom Reynolds will be the rollback authority (tom.reynolds@novaleap.io). I will be the project lead for scheduling and training coordination.
- Training windows: we can do Tues Jan 6 10:00–11:30PT, Wed Jan 7 14:00–15:30PT, or Fri Jan 9 09:00–10:30PT. Please hold those tentatively.

Two notes for gating:
1) We need a short checklist item added for our SOC-2 evidence: specifically that KV/cache retention is documented in the runbook.
2) Can you confirm whether we can do a lightweight perf smoke during the canary window (10% traffic) without needing extra infra pre-provision? If not we’ll need to provision burst nodes.

If Marissa or Soojin want to hop on a quick 20-minute sync Monday, I can schedule.

Best,
Claire
Director, Cloud Ops | Novaleap Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novaleap.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Dec 2025 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: implementation sprint, canary migration & training slots

Claire — thanks, that works. Quick replies inline: 

- Jan 12–16 cutover window: noted. We’ll show a final cutover runbook in the Timeline tab by EOD Monday.
- Contacts: added Tom as rollback authority and you as project lead.
- Training: tentatively holding the three windows you listed — we’ll confirm trainers by Monday.

Gating / SOC2 evidence: we will add a short KV/cache retention section to the runbook (canary-runbook-v1.pdf -> will become v1.1). I’ll ask Soojin to add the exact retention table expected for audit purposes.

Perf smoke: for a 10% canary we can generally use a reserved burst pool for 24 hours and we recommend activating 2x burst nodes for the smoke to give headroom (we’ll only keep them live during the test). If Novaleap prefers not to pre-provision, we can run the canary at 5% initially and metric-validate before scaling to 10% (this is in our Canary Gating tab as Option B). Which would you prefer?

I’ll schedule a 20-minute Monday sync at 10:30 PT unless you propose otherwise.

—
Dylan

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@novaleap.io>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Dec 2025 11:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: implementation sprint, canary migration & training slots

On Sat, Dec 20, 2025 at 10:12 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Claire — thanks, that works. Quick replies inline: 
> 
> - Jan 12–16 cutover window: noted. We’ll show a final cutover runbook in the Timeline tab by EOD Monday.

Thanks all — adding a few operational specifics so the MAP captures gating criteria clearly: 

- Canary gating checklist (we will add to the runbook): service latency P95 within expected baseline; error-rate spike <= 0.5%; prefix/KV cache hit rate >= configured threshold; no more than 2 circuit breakers triggered in 30m.
- Rollback trigger: any sustained (>10m) increase in customer-facing errors that doesn't stabilize after mitigation steps. Tom (cc’d) will be the final rollback authority.
- Runbook handoff: I’ll post the runbook v1.1 to the Drive link and tag the SOC-2 KV/cache section for reviewers.

Training notes — proposed split sessions: "Operator runbook & incident playbook" (90m), "Admin console + routing policy" (60m). I’ll share trainer assignments Monday. We’ll include a short assessment checklist so Novaleap can sign-off on readiness after training.

Attachment: canary-runbook-v1.pdf (annotated)

—
Soojin Lee
Manager, Reliability | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: implementation sprint, canary migration & training slots

Claire / team — I’ve tentatively booked the three training windows Claire suggested and created an internal project milestone for finalizing the cutover checklist (due Mon EOD). I also uploaded a lightweight acceptance form (Drive link) that Novaleap can sign after training so we have a documented readiness gate.

Action items summary for Monday:
- Dylan: finalize Timeline tab + attach final cutover runbook (EOD Mon).
- Soojin: add KV/cache retention table and gating thresholds to runbook (EOD Mon).
- Claire / Tom: confirm whether you prefer 10% with pre-provisioned burst nodes or start at 5% (reply here).

If no objections, I’ll lock the Jan 12 cutover week and schedule a short dry-run the Friday before (Jan 9).

Thanks — Marissa
PM, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
